metadata.method_name: RQ1 volume-normalised structural precursors of concept emergence
metadata.description: Rolling-origin prediction of network-only emergence (screen fold). output = primary E(c,t). predict_<featureset>_<model>[_Ealt|_Eup] are pooled out-of-sample scores at test origins for the primary label, the pool-percentile label E_alt and uptake-only E_up ('NA' = training-only row). BASELINE = frequency/burst + degree/centrality growth + entropy growth; FULL = BASELINE + precursors.
